speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with sudden-onset lower abdominal pain; to help me understand your condition, please tell me your age and sex, and exactly where the pain is located and if it radiates anywhere.

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old male. The patient reports the sudden onset of abdominal pain while playing football two hours ago. He has a past medical history significant only for asthma. Additionally, his social history is notable for unprotected sex with four partners in the past month.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Appendicitis (based on sudden onset lower abdominal pain in a 16-year-old male while playing sports, with social history raising concern for gonococcal epididymitis but acute abdominal pain in this demographic is most consistent with appendicitis; further imaging and labs needed to confirm).
